info.description:
Better Metadata - Better Science

Mutable resources use strong ETags for optimistic concurrency. Read the resource (or its
permissions) and send the returned ETag in `If-Match` when replacing or deleting it. A missing
required precondition returns 428; a stale or malformed validator returns 412. `If-Match: *`
accepts whichever revision currently exists and therefore deliberately gives up lost-update
protection. Comma-separated strong validators are also accepted. Representation suffixes such
as `"7-json"`, `"7-yaml"`, and `"7-resource-record"` identify different bytes of the same
stored revision and are valid write preconditions.

post.description: Deprecated, and does not do what its name says. The rules index holds association rules mined by the value recommender from template instances; the resource server cannot produce those documents. This command creates an empty index, points the alias at it and deletes the old index, so it discards every rule in the system and recommendations stop returning results. The force parameter is read but has no effect. Use /command/generate-empty-rules-index if emptying the index is what you want. To repopulate the index, call the value recommender's /command/generate-rules/{template_id} for each template. Only one rebuild or import runs at a time, and a job that never returns would otherwise hold its claim until the server restarted, refusing every later command with a conflict naming a job that is not running. A claim is believed for six hours; past that the status reports it as overdue and this command takes it back, so the next command can run. It does not stop the abandoned job — nothing can — so run it only once the log shows that job has stopped making progress. A claim within its deadline is left alone, and answers with a conflict.

200.description: The claim was reset, and the index is free

409.description: Nothing is running, or the running job is within its deadline

post.summary: Take back a rules index rebuild that passed its deadline.

ETag.description: Strong validator for the returned representation and its stored revision.

IfMatch.description:
Strong ETag returned by the corresponding GET. `*` accepts any current revision; a
comma-separated list succeeds when any supplied strong validator names the current stored
revision. Weak, stale, and malformed validators fail with 412.
IfMatch.name: If-Match

IfMatchForCreateOrReplace.description:
Required when the identifier already exists and the PUT replaces it; omit it when creating
a resource with a new client-supplied identifier. If supplied for an absent resource, the
request fails with 412 rather than creating it. Use the strong ETag returned by GET. `*`
accepts any current revision that still exists and deliberately gives up lost-update protection.
IfMatchForCreateOrReplace.name: If-Match

PreconditionFailed.description:
The supplied If-Match value is stale, weak, or malformed. When a current revision exists,
the error body's `parameters.currentETag` identifies it.
